Obtaining the Original Advanced Color Imaging Books

The original advanced color imaging books describe version 2.0 of the ColorSync Manager. These books are available online from Apple Computer's developer support Web site at 
http://www.devworld.apple.com/dev/insidemac.shtml
In addition, you can obtain a paper copy of the original Advanced Color Imaging on the Mac OS, including the reference book on an enclosed CD-ROM, from Addison-Wesley Publishing Company. The ISBN number for this book is 0-201-48949-X. To order books or other products through the Apple Developer Catalog, see the Web site at 
http://www.devcatalog.apple.com
